title: Can we get a workshop on LaTeX for report writing
description: Final year students have to write the project report in a fixed format. A one day LaTeX workshop by the department would be useful, if it can be arranged.

title: NPTEL course credits not transferred
description: I cleared two NPTEL courses in the last semester and gave the certificates to the department. The credit transfer is not done even after five weeks.

title: Viva scheduled tomorrow but my name is not in the list
description: The external viva for the project is tomorrow and my group is missing from the schedule sent by the coordinator. If we are not examined we lose the whole project marks.

title: Teacher only reads from the textbook
description: The faculty of thermodynamics just reads out the book in every class and does not solve a single numerical. We raised this with the class teacher last month and it is the same.

title: Doubt about passing criteria in practical subjects
description: Is it necessary to pass separately in the internal and external components of a practical course? Seniors give different answers, so please clarify.

title: Unit test answer sheets never shown to us
description: Answer sheets of the last two unit tests were never returned or shown. We only see a number on the portal and cannot check our mistakes. Asked twice already.

title: Wrong subject code on my exam form, exam is day after tomorrow
description: My exam form has the code of the old syllabus paper printed on it. The exam is in two days and the question paper will be different. The office says nothing can be done now.

title: Migration certificate stuck in the office
description: I applied for the migration certificate a month ago with all the papers. The dealing assistant keeps saying the register is with the registrar.

title: Suggestion for peer mentoring by toppers
description: Weak students could be paired with toppers of the senior batch for an hour every week. Something like this is done in other institutes and works well.

title: Grace marks not applied, readmission list comes out tomorrow
description: I am short by one mark in a subject and am eligible for grace marks as per the ordinance. The list of students to be sent back a year is being finalised tomorrow.

title: Mess plates and glasses are not washed properly
description: The steel plates in the mess are oily and have leftover food sticking on them. We have pointed it out to the mess staff many times over the last two weeks.

title: Can hostel students get a microwave in the pantry
description: A microwave or induction plate in the floor pantry would let us heat milk and food at night. Requesting the hostel committee to think about it.

title: Boy fell from first floor because of missing grill
description: The corridor window on the first floor of our hostel has had no grill for a long time. Tonight a student leaning there fell down and has a fracture.

title: Mosquito problem in hostel, no fogging done
description: There are swarms of mosquitoes in the rooms as the drain behind the hostel is choked. Fogging was promised three weeks back. Two boys already have malaria.

title: Hostel notice board is not updated
description: The notice board near the hostel entrance still has last year's mess menu and old notices. Kindly keep it updated, it is a small thing.

title: Room door does not lock
description: The bolt of my hostel room door is broken so the room cannot be locked when I go to class. I reported it to the caretaker eight days ago.

title: Gas cylinder leaking in mess kitchen
description: There is a strong gas smell in the hostel mess since evening and the cook says one cylinder is leaking. Dinner is still being cooked next to it.

title: Overhead tank not cleaned for months
description: The water in the bathroom taps has small worms and green particles. The tank on the terrace has not been cleaned for months and our requests are ignored.

title: Permission to keep a small cooler in room
description: Summer is coming. Are students allowed to keep a personal air cooler in the hostel room, and is there any extra electricity charge?

title: Drunk outsiders created a scene inside hostel last night
description: A few drunk men from outside entered the hostel compound at midnight, banged on room doors and broke a window. There was no guard. Students are frightened.

title: Mic and speakers in the lecture theatre do not work
description: In the big lecture theatre the mic has been dead for a month, students at the back cannot hear anything the teacher says. It was reported to the office.

title: Please keep a photocopy shop inside campus
description: For every printout we have to go a kilometre outside the gate. A xerox and stationery shop inside the campus would save a lot of time.

title: Electric pole fell on the ground near playground with wires live
description: A light pole near the playground has fallen after the rain and the wires are lying in the water. Children of staff play there. Somebody could die.

title: Printer in the library is always out of order
description: The single printer for students in the library has not worked for three weeks. Project reports have to be printed outside at double the cost.

title: Ramp required at the entrance of the admin building
description: The admin building has only steps at the entrance. I suggest a ramp be built so that wheelchair users can enter without help.

title: Bad smell and garbage dump behind the classroom block
description: Garbage has been piling up behind the first year classrooms for two weeks. The smell comes into class through the windows and flies are everywhere.

title: Chemical bottle burst in the lab store
description: A bottle of acid burst in the chemistry store room this morning and the liquid has spread to the lab floor. One attendant has burns. Students are still being sent in.

title: Auditorium seats are broken
description: Many seats in the auditorium have broken hinges and torn cushions. During the last three events people had to stand. Nothing has been repaired since.

title: Could the ground be levelled for football
description: The football ground has uneven patches. Before the inter college matches it would be nice to have it levelled and the lines marked.

title: Speeding vehicles on campus hit a student today
description: There are no speed breakers on the road in front of the academic block. A car hit a second year student today and he is in the hospital.

title: Prize money of technical fest not paid
description: I won the first prize in the paper presentation at our college fest in February. The cash prize announced has not been handed over for four months.

title: Is GST charged on hostel fee
description: My receipt has a tax line this year. I want to understand whether GST applies on hostel and mess charges. Only a clarification is needed.

title: Exam fee window closes tonight and my fee head is missing
description: The exam fee option is not appearing in my login and the window closes at midnight today. Without paying it I cannot sit for the semester exams.

title: Amount debited for alumni membership without consent
description: An alumni association fee of 2,000 was added to my final year dues without asking me. I wrote to accounts three weeks ago to remove it.

title: Request to accept fee by cheque
description: My sponsor pays by cheque only. Does the accounts section accept an outstation cheque for the tuition fee, and in whose name should it be drawn?

title: Uniform and kit money taken but items not supplied
description: At admission we paid 3,500 for lab coat, uniform and drawing kit. Half the semester is over and neither the items nor the money has come back.

title: Officer wants cash to release my original documents
description: The person in charge of the document section says I must give him 3,000 in cash, with no receipt, to get my original certificates back. I have a joining date next week and he knows it. He is asking for a bribe.

title: Scholarship credited is less than sanctioned
description: The sanction letter says 48,000 but only 30,000 was passed on to me by the college. The office has not explained the difference for a month.

title: How to get fee paid certificate for visa
description: I need a certificate listing all fees paid during the course for my visa file. What is the process and the charge for it?

title: Fine for ID card collected twice
description: I paid the fine for a lost ID card in cash and again it was added in my semester dues. The second amount is not reversed after two visits.

title: Seniors made juniors drink alcohol forcibly
description: In the hostel on Saturday night some seniors forced first year boys to drink and smoke and filmed it. One boy became unconscious. This is ragging of the worst kind.

title: Roommate constantly taunts me about money
description: My roommate makes fun of my old phone and clothes in front of his friends and calls me a beggar. It happens every day and I feel very low.

title: Professor sends late night personal messages
description: A professor messages me at night asking what I am wearing and whether I am alone. When I did not reply he said my internal marks are in his hands.

title: Called names for my skin colour and denied entry in team
description: The captain of the college team uses racist words for me and has told others not to pass the ball to me. I am being discriminated in selection as well.

title: Where is the helpline number for reporting misconduct by seniors displayed
description: New students should know whom to call. I could not find the helpline number or the squad members' names anywhere in the hostel. Please put up posters.

title: Ex-boyfriend from my class threatens to throw acid
description: A classmate I stopped talking to has told my friends he will throw acid on my face. He waits near my PG every evening. I am terrified.

title: Class representative humiliates quiet students
description: Our CR mocks students who do not speak much, reads out their marks loudly and laughs. Several of us have asked him to stop over the last few weeks.

title: Man exposing himself near girls hostel road
description: For the last three evenings a man on a scooter stops near the girls hostel road and exposes himself to passing students. We are scared to walk there.

title: Beaten for refusing to share exam answers
description: Two boys dragged me to the washroom after the exam and punched me because I did not show them my paper. They said tomorrow will be worse.

title: Lab partner keeps making remarks on my religion's festivals
description: My lab partner regularly passes sarcastic comments about my fasting and festivals and encourages others to laugh. I have told him it hurts me.
